pay_detail: Paid internship program; pay rate not stated
duration: Flexible hours; the museum usually hires two summer interns
name: Teen Apprentice (Teen Internship) Program
what_you_do: A paid internship at the museum. You go through a real application and interview. You work with the public, help with studio classes, and plan and present a research project.
who_can_apply: Teens 16 and older who like art, museums or teaching.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the teen page. Check the museum's Job Opportunities page to see if it is hiring.
how_to_apply: Look at the Job Opportunities page of the Worcester Art Museum. Apply when jobs are posted.
notes: The page says a grant from the National Endowment for the Arts supports the NEA Teen Intern jobs. Ask the museum about a Massachusetts work permit.
